## AccrualVault.apy property

The MetaMorpho vault's current instantaneous Annual Percentage Yield (APY) weighted-averaged over its market deposits, before deducting the performance fee. If interested in the APY at a specific timestamp, use `getApy(timestamp)` instead.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get apy(): number;
```
